title: The text discusses the rescheduling of the FIFA Confederations Cup due to conflicts with club games, and the subsequent reshuffling of the tournament dates and locations. It also announces that the United States, China, Germany, and Norway will be the four seeds for next summer's Women's World Cup, and provides details on the 16-team tournament to be played in eight US cities from June 19-July 10. Additionally, the text mentions that only female referees will be used at the tournament, and appeals to the government and well-meaning Nigerians and corporate bodies to contribute towards maintaining a clean and healthy environment for the successful hosting of the World Youth Soccer Championship in Nigeria.
